source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "street vending" OR "street vendors" OR "street hawkers" OR hawkers OR "street trading"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"street vending" OR "street vendors" OR "street hawkers" OR hawkers OR "street trading",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("street hawkers" OR "street trading" OR "street vending" OR "street vendors" OR "hawkers")
